about: The demo video's script as data (5 Nov, the 3:00 cut). Browser beats play by themselves (director.js); the 3D fab and the cinema are recorded between the two chains.

items: Hello! Thank you for this opportunity. This is my project, Fab Gym: a digital twin of a semiconductor fab, and we'll tackle one problem to get a feel for it. I'm joined by my friend, Mr. Lou Latency.
Mr. Lou has the best wafer fabs in the world, in his own words, and he wants us to raise this factory's throughput.
It's a queueing problem. He has an impressive cast of tools, but every lot crosses hundreds of steps, 583 for one product, on 1,043 shared machines and rails.
Scheduling, layout, and a thousand more: far too many answers to try them all. So Meta's models make the first guesses, and our Rust simulator predicts their impact.

beats.screen: App · the ask bar: Muse Spark Open live
items: Watch. I ask a what-if in plain words. Muse Spark Open, Meta's open-weights model, turns it into an experiment: what changes, what to compare, every value marked said or assumed.
The simulator runs today's fab against each answer on ten paired seeds and reports the difference with 95% intervals. I read the card, and I sign.

0.ask: What if the polishers break down twice as often? Would capping the work in the fab protect output?

beats.screen: The rule Muse Spark Open wrote tonight
items: Muse Spark Open also writes the dispatch rule itself, in Rust, scored on days it never saw. Tonight's rule tied the fab's own rule, with about two hundred fewer queue-time breaches.
And you don't have to take the model's word for it. Every scored run is checked by a referee written in Lean: 120 of 120 passed. And on a teaching fab, Muse Spark supervising added 117 wafers a day.
For layouts, design your own fab right in the browser, or race Muse Wonder, Meta's model, playing the same challenge with the same moves you have.
Fab Gym is open: play it in your browser, run it locally with your own key, or load it as a reinforcement-learning environment.

godot.screen: 3D fab: Lou's brain is Muse Spark Open
godot.say: In the 3D fab, Lou's brain is Muse Spark Open, fed the live run. He answers only with the simulator's numbers, and walks you there.
And yes: a cinema, for the films his studio made with Meta's models.
